ResultsDir.description: Default output directory for build artifacts.

InjectedPkgsDir.description: Directory for pre-injected package files (root or per-image subdirs).

DefaultBootstrapVariant.description: Default variant used for bootstrapping with debootstrap. Set to 'none' for no variant.

SyscallFilter.description: List of system call names or set names for systemd-nspawn system call filtering. Special values: 'compat', 'nspawn-default'.

AllowUnsafePermissions.description: If true, allow unsafe options (e.g., host /dev, /proc) in debspawn run.

CachePackages.description: If false, debspawn will not manage its own APT package cache.

BootstrapTool.description: Bootstrap tool (must be compatible with debootstrap interface).
